content: Disk-backed exact counting costs (KMC3 as reference): temp disk is the real budget - up to 350 GB for GIAB (WABI 2022), ~596 GB temp at k=28 for a 729 Gbase human dataset with ~33 GB RAM (NUS CS4330 notes), 32 GB RAM / 389 GB temp for 614 GB input (KMC README). KMC creates HUNDREDS of intermediate files and its docs recommend a dedicated temp dir and raising macOS open-file limit (ulimit -n 2048). I/O cost is the dominant performance factor for disk-based counters (Bioinformatics btab797). Exact counts preserved (KMC3 used as the Exact baseline vs approximate Dashing). No authoritative source found for -m/-sm strict-memory-mode semantics in this pass - flagged LOW if asserted.
